summary: The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews and recommend two candidates to City Council for appointment to the Exhibition Place Board.
decided: City Council on April 16 and 17, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the following candidates to the Exhibition Place Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on April 16, 2023, and until successors are appointed: Peter Leon Tess Romain 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1, 2, 3 and 4 to the report (March 25, 2019) from the City Clerk remain confidential their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Exhibition Place Board. Confidential Attachments 1, 2, 3 and 4 to the report (March 25, 2019) from the City Clerk remain confidential their entirety in accordance with the provisions of the City of Toronto Act, 2006, as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Exhibition Place Board.

motions.desc: Majority required - CA5.4 - Adopt the item
